content: We compare the performance of BERT-QC with recently reported performance on this dataset in Table TABREF11 . BERT-QC achieves state-of-the-art performance on fine-grained classification (TREC-50) for a learned model at 92.0% accuracy, and near state-of-the-art performance on coarse classification (TREC-6) at 96.2% accuracy.
